Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Rohit Sharma and Ishan Kishan are the openers for India. Kemar Roach will begin the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now then, the target is not a big one and this should be chased down easily! Windies will need a miracle if they are to defend this. To start with, they need wickets quickly. Can they do so? We will find out.

Washington Sundar is down for a chat! He says that he feels good to be back in the Indian colours. Mentions that it's great to get some turn first up, and he and Yuzvendra Chahal both enjoyed bowling on this pitch. Adds that in one-day games mostly everyone prefers to start with seamers and he is used to bowling in the eighth and ninth overs. States that the target is not big, and they should get over the line comfortably.

The Windies' batting was extremely poor. None of the top 6 managed to cross the 20-run mark. Their highest score came from the man walking in at number 7, Holder who scored a fine half-ton. Had it not been for him and Allen, Windies would have been bowled out for maybe below 100 but the stand between the two has given some respectability to the score.

End of a really good performance with the ball by India and they will be mighty pleased with how things stand at the moment. It was Siraj who started it off but the spinners were the highlight in this innings. Both Sundar and Chahal were absolutely brilliant and they managed to bag 7 wickets amongst them. Prasidh Krishna also had a decent outing. Shardul Thakur will be a touch disappointed with his effort but overall India will be really happy.

OUT! TAKEN! Yuzvendra Chahal gets his fourth and wraps the innings! Tosses this one up, full and on middle. Alzarri Joseph looks to go over long on, but fails to get any timing on that shot. The ball flies high and lands straight to Suryakumar Yadav at long on. West Indies end at 176!
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten again! A fuller ball, another leg break! Alzarri Joseph hangs back and looks to defend but gets beaten as the ball spins away!
Fuller, outside off. Alzarri Joseph pushes it towards cover.
Flighted again, around middle. Alzarri Joseph heaves it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Beaten! A lovely delivery! A loopy ball lands it around leg stump and spins away outside off. Alzarri Joseph tries to defend but gets beaten.
Change of pace this time! A slower ball, at 93 clicks, fuller, outside off. Kemar Roach looks to drive bt gets beaten!
Fraction shorter, around middle. Kemar Roach presents the full face of his bat and defends it out.
Another toe-crusher! A yorker, around off. Kemar Roach digs it out back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off. Kemar Roach leans and leaves it alone.
Yorker-length delivery, around middle. Kemar Roach squeezes it out. Dot ball!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Kemar Roach pushes it to point.
WIDE! On a length, spraying it down the leg side. Kemar Roach looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
Tad shorter, around middle. Alzarri Joseph pushes it towards mid-wicket. Dot to end the over.
A leg spinner, outside off, shorter in length. Alzarri Joseph pushes it towards cover.
Another fuller ball, on the pads this time. Alzarri Joseph defends it out.
SIX! BOOM! A clean strike! Tosses this one up, very full, outside off. Alzarri Joseph waits for it and tonks it over long off for a biggie.
Shorter ball, around middle. Alzarri Joseph taps it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Alzarri Joseph blocks it out.
Another length ball, outside off. Kemar Roach lets that go through.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Kemar Roach leaves it alone.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Prasidh Krishna comes back on and grabs the wicket of the big fish! A fine innings comes to an end! This one was pitched on a length, outside off, getting some extra bounce there. Jason Holder looks to cut this away on the off side, but he gets a thick outside edge back to the keeper. Rishabh Pant behind the stumps pouches it safely. West Indies are now 9 down!
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length delivery, around middle. Jason Holder pushes it back to the bowler.
Beaten! On a length, outside off. Jason Holder looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Very full, outside off. Jason Holder drives it towards cover. Two is the call and they pick up two runs easily.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Flatter, around middle. Alzarri Joseph works it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller in length, tosses it up this time. Jason Holder knocks it to long on for a single.
Short, on middle. Jason Holder blocks it out.
Back of a length, spinning it on middle. Jason Holder pushes it towards mid on.
Another shorter one, around middle. Alzarri Joseph pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, around middle. Jason Holder works it away towards square leg for a single.
On a length, outside off. Alzarri Joseph pushes it towards cover.
Fuller ball, around middle. Alzarri Joseph blocks it out.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Not the best delivery by Shardul Thakur! A length ball, around the thigh pads. Alzarri Joseph works it away towards fine leg for a boundary.
Overpitches this one, around middle. Jason Holder knocks it towards long on for a single.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Jason Holder pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off. Jason Holder taps it to point.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Another soft dismissal! Washington Sundar strikes and break this partnership! He grabs another wicket. A flatter ball, short in length, around off. Fabian Allen looks to punch this towards long on, but the ball goes off the bottom of the bat, towards the bowler. Washington Sundar gets low and takes good return catch. Fabian Allen walks back and West Indies lose their 8th wicket!
shorter ball, around middle. Jason Holder clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and quicker, around middle. Jason Holder pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter ball, around off. Jason Holder pulls it towards long on for a brace. That brings up his 50! A really good innings under pressure! But he knows his job is only half done here.
Shorter ball, around middle. Jason Holder stays back and taps it towards square leg.
Loopy ball, fuller in length, this one lands on middle and spins in. Jason Holder looks to defend but gets rapped on the pads.
Tad shorter, outside off. Fabian Allen taps it towards cover. Dot to end the over!
Good-length delivery, jagging back in on the pads. Fabian Allen looks to defend this but gets beaten and gets hit high on the pads.
Fuller ball, around off. Jason Holder drives it gently towards mid off and rotates the strike
Outside off, on a length. Jason Holder dabs it to point. No run there!
Good-length delivery, around middle. Jason Holder flicks it towards deep square leg. Two runs taken! Good running!
SIX! Magnificent strike! A length ball, around middle. Jason Holder heaves it towards deep square leg for a biggie! 150 up for West Indies!
This one kept low! A flatter ball, around middle. Fabian Allen blocks it out. Tidy over by Washington Sundar.
Flatter ball, around middle. Jason Holder pushes it towards square leg for a single.
Shorter one, flatter, around middle. Fabian Allen works it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, around middle. Fabian Allen pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter ball, spinning it in around middle. Jason Holder knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike.
A fuller ball, around off. Jason Holder hangs back and defends it out.
Tad fuller, on middle. Fabian Allen blocks it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Fabian Allen, on back foot, looks to push this away but gets an under-edge towards third man.
WIDE! Shorter in length, down the leg side. Fabian Allen leaves it alone and wide is called.
Length ball, around middle. Fabian Allen taps it to mid-wicket.
Shorter ball, outside off. Fabian Allen leans and pushes it towards deep backward point. Two runs taken.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Jason Holder just taps it on the off side and scampers through to the other end.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Jason Holder dabs it to point.
Down the leg side, Holder looks took to sweep, it goes off the glove for one towards short fine leg. Leg bye signaled so it may have been off the pad.
On middle, blocked.
SIX! What a hit that is! Lovely shot! Makes room, this is full and on off, Holder lifts it beautifully over the long off fence.
On middle, defended.
On off, this is hit down to long off for one.
On middle, Holder looks to work it on the leg side, it goes off the leading edge through point for one.
Angled into the pads, this is nudged around the corner for one.
On off, blocked.
Short and on the body, this is pulled down to fine leg for one.
On off, blocked.
Allen makes room and he is followed, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle, Holder pushes it back to the bowler.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Lovely delivery! Flatter and on middle, this lands and then spins away. Holder is beaten as he tries to defend.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

SIX! Just wide of the fielder! On middle, the slog sweep is out, it is hit flat and to the left of the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Prasidh Krishna runs to his left, he actually gets two hands to it but it goes through and over the fence. That is a DROP! Prasidh could have done better, not an easy chance but a chance.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Up and over! Short and wide, asking to be hit, Allen cuts it over point for a boundayr. This is a good partnership for the Windies.
On the stumps, defended.
A slight halt in play. Jason Holder seems to have hurt his thumb. The physio is out there to have a check on him. He gets the required treatment and we are good to go!
Off the glove! A quick bumper on the body, Holder is late on the pull, it goes off the glove and lobs on the leg side for one.
This one jags back in from outside off, Allen looks to defend but gets na inside edge onto the leg side. A run taken.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Angled into the pads, Holder looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.

DRINKS! A partnership is being built here for West Indies! Fabian Allen and Jason Holder are looking solid and trying to rebuild from here. India still on top! It's been a good bowling performance, very disciplined! They will be looking to break this partnership. Mohammed Siraj (5-2-13-1) is back into the attack.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! A loopy ball, outside off. Fabian Allen gets low and slog-sweeps this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Around middle, flatter delivery. Jason Holder pushes it to long on off the back foot for a single.
Around off, fuller delivery. Jason Holder pushes it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up again, outside off. Fabian Allen dabs it to point for a single.
A loopy ball, fuller in length, outside off. Fabian Allen advances down the pitch and looks to go over cover, but he gets a thick outside edge over the Rohit Sharma at first slip. Two runs taken.
A shorter ball, around middle. Fabian Allen defends it out.

NOT OUT! Three in the end! This is shorter, Allen pulls it past mid on. Chahal runs after it, slides and pushes it back in. The batters completed two and Allen wanted the third and sets off. He is sent back from halfway down. The throw from Chahal is at the bowler's end which is collected by Kohli who hits the stumps at the keeper's end then. The ball deflects away from the fielder backing up and the batters go for an overthrow. The Indians are appealing and it is referred. The umpire first checks if the stop by Chahal is clean which is. Then he goes onto check the run out and replays show that Allen is in.
Is that a run out? There is a throw at the keeper's end. The replays show that the batsman has comfortably made his ground. NOT OUT!
On middle, defended.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for two.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Misfiled! On middle, this is worked through mid on. Chahal runs to his right but slides over the ball, he gets back to his feet and runs behind the ball, stops it before the ropes. Saves a run.
Angled in on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On the stumps, blocked.
BEATEN! This lands on off and then spins away. Allen is beaten as he tries to defend.
Close! On middle, Allen defends it with soft hands. It lands and then spins backwards but goes past the leg pole.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
Allen steps out after seeing the tossed up ball, he looks to go through the off side but it goes off the inner half through mid on for one.
Tossed up on middle, defended.
Short and on the body, Allen looks to pull, it goes more off the glove and down to fine leg for one.
Another one on a length, it is kept out.
Back of a length and on off, blocked.
A short one on the body, Allen evades it.
Good length and on off, Allen pushes it to covers.
On off, defended.
Outside off, left alone.
Gives it air and bowls it on off, Allen looks to go big but mistimes it to long off for one.
On middle, a full toss, this is driven back firmly towards the bowler who gets down and makes a half stop. No run.
Floats it up on off, Allen strokes it to covers.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Nicely played! On middle, Holder plays it nice and fine on the leg side for two.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
A yorker now on off, Allen jams it through covers for one.
An effort ball, short and on middle, Allen ducks under it.
Shorter and on off, Holder shuffles and works it through square leg for one.
And again, driven nicely but straight to the cover fielder.
Fuller and on off, Holder drives but to covers.
Shorter one, around middle. Jason Holder clips it square leg for a single. He retains the strike.
Tosses this one up, around off. Jason Holder looks to drive but gets an inside edge back to the bowler.
A quicker one, around middle. Jason Holder stays back and defends it out.
SIX! Bang! Something to smile about for West Indies! A fuller ball, on middle. Jason Holder gets low and slaps this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie! First six of the innings!
Flatter this time, outside off. Jason Holder pushes it to cover.
Shorter ball, around middle. Jason Holder defends it out.
Fuller ball, outside off. Fabian Allen looks to drive but misses!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Prasidh Krishna strikes this time! Akeal Hosein walks back early to the hut. He has been good in the spell and has been rewarded for the same! A shorter ball, outside off. Akeal Hosein looks to cut this away but gets an under-edge back to the keeper. Rishabh Pant behind the stumps dives to his right and takes a good catch. The umpire's check if that has been taken cleanly, and the replays confirm that it was a clean catch by Rishabh Pant. West Indies are now 7 down!
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: Have India got another one? They have gone upstairs to check if the ball has carried.

An appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! A length ball, coming back in this time. Akeal Hosein looks to defend this but misses and gets hit on the pads. The impact was probably outside. No review taken this time!
Extra bounce! A shorter ball, outside off. Jason Holder leans back and dabs it towards third man for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Jason Holder shows the full face of the ball and defends it out.
Outside off, on a length. Jason Holder leaves it alone.
A loopy ball, on middle. Akeal Hosein blocks it out. Another successful over by India!
Akeal Hosein walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another one bites the dust! West Indies continue to tumble! Another successful review for India! Yuzvendra Chahal gets his third wicket! A beauty by him! A loopy ball, spinning it away from off this time, full in length. Shamarh Brooks leans and looks to defend. There are a couple of sounds as the ball passes the bat. A huge appeal by India and once again, the Indian's have heard something and they go up for the review. The replay rolls in and UltraEdge confims there is a spike as the ball passes through the bat! The decision has to be overturned!
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Another review! This time for caught behind as another appeal has been turned down. Will it be three in a row? We did hear someone say that it has hit the bat and the bat has hit the pad too.
A loopy ball this time, on the pads. Shamarh Brooks looks to sweeps and gets under-edge towards fine leg for a brace.
Tad shorter, outside off. Jason Holder, on back foot, taps it towards cover for a single.
A leg-break this time, outside off. Jason Holder pushes it towards deep cover for a brace.
Loopy ball, around middle. Jason Holder blocks it out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks leaves it alone.
Tad fuller, outside off. Jason Holder drives it gently past cover for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Jason Holder looks to push this on the off side but gets an inside edge back to the bowler.
Shorter ball, outside off. Jason Holder leaves it alone.
A low full toss, on middle. Jason Holder drives it to mid off.
On a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks taps it to point off the back foot. A single taken.
Tossed up, on middle. Jason Holder leans and defends it out. That ends a brilliant first over of Yuzvendra Chahal!
Loopy ball, fuller in length, around off. Jason Holder leans and gets an inside edge towards the short leg fielder!
Jason Holder walks out to bat!

OUT! TIMBER! Googly does the trick this time! Two in two for Yuzvendra Chahal! Kieron Pollard departs for a first-ball duck and half of his side is back! A googly, fuller in length, pitching it outside off and turning back in. Kieron Pollard leans and looks to drive, but fails to pick up the googly and gets beaten. The ball goes on to knock the off stump over! Yuzvendra Chahal is on a hat-trick here! Pollard just did not pick that one, he looked to play it against the turn through the off side and that proved to be his downfall. Spin proving to be the undoing for the Windies again. We saw it against Ireland, against England, and now the Indian spinners doing it.
Review time! A huge appeal but an LBW has been turned down. India review. Impact could be an issue.

OUT!  LBW! Another successful review for India! Yuzvendra Chahal strikes in his first over and sends Nicholas Pooran back to the hut! Spinners doing the magic for India! Tosses this one up, full in length, around off. Nicholas Pooran gets low and goes for the sweep but misses and gets rapped on the front pad. A huge appeal by the Indians. But the umpire says no. Rohit Sharma opts for the review! No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tacker indicates three reds! The decision has to be overturned once again! Yuzvendra Chahal gets his 100th wicket in ODIs!
Another fuller ball, around middle. Shamarh Brooks knocks it to long on for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal starts with a loopy ball, fuller and on middle. Shamarh Brooks leans and defends it out.
Dot to the end the over! Another shorter ball, outside off. Nicholas Pooran dabs it to point once again.
Fraction shorter, outside off once again. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and taps it towards point.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Nicholas Pooran leaves it alone.
On a length, around middle. Shamarh Brooks looks to flicks this on the leg side, but gets a leading edge towards mid off. A single taken.
Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks dabs it towards point. No run there!
Shorter ball, down the leg side. Shamarh Brooks ducks and lets that go through.
Another fuller ball, around middle. Shamarh Brooks knocks it to long on for a single.
Tosses this one up, around off. Shamarh Brooks blocks it towards cover.
Tad quicker, around off. Nicholas Pooran pushes it towards cover for a single.
Tosses this one up, on middle. Nicholas Pooran leans and blocks it out.

FOUR! Misfield and four! A fuller ball, around middle. Nicholas Pooran gets low and sweeps this towards short fine leg fielder. Prasidh Krishna there fails to grab the ball, and the ball races away towards the fence for a boundary.
Fuller ball, tosses this one up, on middle. Nicholas Pooran defends it out.

DRINKS! India are in control of this game! They got the top three of the Windies and have also kept the run rate in check. Really good stuff from their bowlers so far and they would want the same to continue. Windies on the other hand, need a partnership. They need these two to bat for a long time. Can they do so? We will find out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks stays back and taps it towards point. Dot the end the over! Good over from Prasidh Krishna, just 2 runs off it!
Fuller in length this time, around the off pole. Shamarh Brooks presents the full face of the bat and defends it out.
Prasidh Krishna drops it short this time, down the leg side. Shamarh Brooks ducks underneath it.
Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks guides it towards third man for a brace.
Length ball, around middle. Shamarh Brooks gets an outside edge towards point again. Dot ball!
Tad fuller, wide of off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it to wards point. Suryakumar Yadav there, makes a good stop.
Quicker and flatter, on middle. Nicholas Pooran plays it back to the bowler. Dot to end the over.
Touch shorter, around middle. Nicholas Pooran defends it out.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Slower through the air this one, full in length, wide of off. Nicholas Pooran presses forward and slashes this one towards deep point for a boundary.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Shamarh Brooks stays in his crease and cuts it towards deep point and rotates the strike.
Loopy ball, full and on off. Nicholas Pooran drives it towards deep cover for a single.
Slower through the air, spins away from outside off. Nicholas Pooran pushes it back to the bowler.
A single to end! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Good length and on off, Pooran plays it to covers.
Two is the call and two is what they get! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Just outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Back of a length and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Short and on middle, Brooks evades it.
A lot of spin there! This lands on off and then spins away, there is also extra bounce. Pooran is beaten as he tries to block.
Angled into the pads, Pooran thinks of tucking it on the leg side but then this one straightens, he keeps it out.
Flatter and on off, Pooran pushes it towards cover, Kohli there dives to his right and saves a run for his side.
Flatter and on the stumps, Pooran blocks.
On the stumps, kept out.
On middle, defended.
Good length again and on off, Brooks keeps it out.
On off, Pooran drives it through covers for one.
Back of a length now and corrects his line, bowls it on off, blocked.
FOUR! Nice and fine! On the pads, Pooran flicks it, this one races away to the fine leg fence. A good way for Pooran to get off the mark.
Fuller and on off, Brooks drives it nicely through covers for one.
Good length and on off, defended.

Review! India have reviewed an LBW decision against Darren Bravo. The replay rolls in. No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Trackers shows all three reds and Darren Bravo has to walk back. The decision has to be overturned. A successful review for India!

OUT! THREE REDS AND SUNDAR HAS TWO IN THE OVER! Both the batters who had spent a little time out there, were just about getting used to the conditions have beeen dismissed in the space of 5 balls. Windies now in big trouble. The flatter delivery does the trick, it lands on middle and then straightens just a touch. Bravo misses the flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but the umpire turns it down. After a chat where Pant is heard saying it is quite close, Rohit reviews. Replays show it is a good one and the on-field call has to be overturned.
On middle, defended.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one. Brooks is off the mark.
Tosses this one up on off, Brooks blocks.
Shamarh Brooks walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a soft dismissal and the stand which was building nicely has been broken! Sundar back into the side and back amongst the wickets. He has been impressive so far and gets the reward! This lands on off and then turns back in. Just about holds in the surface. King is slightly early in the flick. It goes uppishly towards mid-wicket where Yadav takes a good catch diving to his right.
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Washington Sundar

Commentary.Commentary: A quick run! On middle, Bravo nudges it on the leg side and gets to the other end.
On off, defended.
Leg bye! Angled into the pads, Bravo looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A run taken.
Nicely timed! Length and on off, Bravo just leans into the stroke and pushes it through covers for two.
On middle, Bravo defends it nicely.
Close! Length and on off, King looks to stroke it on the up, the ball just about holds in the surface, it goes off the inside edge, past the leg pole, down to fine leg for one.
Starts well, on a good length and on off, defended.
It's time Powerplay 2! Now a total of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Shardul Thakur comes into the attack.
Another one on the pads, Bravo looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. So, after that early boundary, just a wide. Good comeback from the bowler.
On middle, this is played back to the bowler.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Bravo looks to flick but misses.
Close! This is quicker and on middle, stays a touch low. Bravo gets his bat down in time and plays it to mid-wicket.
On middle, defended.
FOUR! That is brilliantly timed! This is tossed up nicely, it is slightly fuller and on off, Bravo drives, his one hand comes off the handle but still finds the gap through covers for a boundary.
Flatter and on middle, Bravo works it to mid-wicket.
Shorter in length and on off, King hops and guides it to point.
Short and on middle, King looks to pull, this goes more off the inner half through square leg for two.
Back to attacking the stumps, King blocks.
Two! Shorter and outside off, King hits it hard into the ground, it goes over point for two.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Fuller in length and on off, King strokes it back towards the bowler who dives and stops it.
A couple to end a testing over from Sundar! He goes flat but bowls it shorter and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for two.
Beautiful stuff! Once again tosses it up, gets it to drift back in from outside off, it lands and then spins away. Beats the outside edge of Bravo as he tries to block.
BEAUTY! Now slows it up, gives it air and lands it on off, this pitches and then spins away. Bravo is beaten as he tries to defend.
Again, flatter and on middle, a little quicker, it goes on with the arm. Blocked.
Now flatter and on middle, Bravo defends.

Sharp turn there! We are just in the 8th over and it is just the 4th over with this ball, quite relatively new but that was a lot of turn. This is slower through the air, it lands on middle and then straightens. Bravo looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Washington Sundar comes into the attack. He replaces Prasidh Krishna.
A dot to end which means a maiden by Siraj! On off, this is pushed to covers.
Sharp from Siraj! Goes short now and on middle, King initially looks to pull but then realises it is way too quick. Lets it go.
Good length and on off, King pushes it to covers. 4 dots in a row.
On middle, King plays it with a straight bat to mid on.
Getting it to land and come in is Siraj! On middle, length, it pitches and then comes back in. King looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Angled into the pads, King looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Crunched! Much fuller this time, outside off. Darren Bravo presses forward and smashes this past cover for a boundary!
Tad shorter, around off. Darren Bravo defends it out.
FOUR! Lucky boundary! Good delivery by Prasidh Krishna. A shorter ball, around middle, at 144 clicks. Darren Bravo looks to pull, but he gets a top edge towards fine leg for a boundary!
On a length, shaping away from outside off. Darren Bravo leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off, at 137.1 clicks. Darren Bravo shoulders his arms at it.
Short of a length, outside off. Darren Bravo leans and lets that go through.
Tad shorter, on the pads. Darren Bravo works it away towards fine leg for a single. He gets off the mark with that!
Length, outside off, at 132.3 clicks. Darren Bravo offers no shot on that!
Good-length delivery, shaping away from outside off. Darren Bravo once again, lets that go through.
On a length, outside off, shaping away. Darren Bravo leaves it alone.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Darren Bravo looks to flick it on the leg side, but gets a leading edge towards cover.
Back of a length, around off. Darren Bravo stays in his crease and defends it out.
Length ball, around off. Brandon King defends it out.
Much better delivery this time! On a length, shaping away from outside off. Brandon King looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Top shot! A fuller delivery, outside off, at around 126 clicks. Brandon King presses forward and drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Length ball, around middle. Brandon King shows the full face of the bat and blocks it out.
LEG BYE! Fraction shorter, around middle. Darren Bravo looks to flick again but misses. The ball deflects off the pads and rolls towards fine leg for another leg bye!
Back of a length, outside off. Darren Bravo, on back foot, pushes it towards cover.

LEG BYE! Shorter ball, on the pads again. Darren Bravo looks to flick but misses, the ball brushes off the thigh pads and rolls towards fine leg. A leg bye taken. End of a successful over by Mohammed Siraj!
Good-length delivery, darting it on the thigh pads. Rishabh Pant dives to his right and makes a good stop!

OUT! CHOPPED ON! A great comeback by Mohammed Siraj! He strikes in his second over and India have their first wicket! Tad fuller again, outside off, forcing the batsman to drive once again. Shai Hope leans to drive but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. West Indies have lost an early wicket! Darren Bravo is the new man in. That actually came back in a little. It was a scrambled seam delivery and hence, it pitched and came back in. Also, it is Siraj's MAIDEN ODI WICKET!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Much fuller, outside off. Shai Hope prods and drives it beautifully past cover for another boundary!
FOUR! Shai Hope gets off the mark in style! Tad fuller, width on offer. Shai Hope leans and carves it past cover-point for a boundary.
Fraction shorter, around the pads. Shai Hope taps it towards mid-wicket. No run there!
Tad shorter, outside off. Brandon King lets that go through.
Lenth ball, an outswinger, around off. Brandon King blocks it out.
Tad full, swinging it away from outside off, at 136.1 clicks. Brandon King offers no shot on that.
Another length ball, outside off. Brandon King leaves it alone.
WIDE! Prasidh Krishna sprays this one down the leg side, on a length. Brandon King looks to flick and misses. Wide called!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Brandon King lets that go through to the keeper.
FOUR! First runs and the first boundary for Brandon King and West Indies! Prasidh Krishna begins with a fuller ball, wide of off. Brandon King leans and slashes this past cover-point for a boundary.
Length ball, around middle. Shai Hope, on the back foot, looks to block but gets an inside edge towards the leg side. A maiden over to begin with!
Touch fuller, around off. Shai Hope drives and gets an inside edge onto his pad.
Shorter ball, outside off. Shai Hope stays back and pushes it to cover. No run there!
Good-length delivery, outside off, at 133.4 clicks. Shai Hope looks to drive but gets a slight inside edge back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off. Shai Hope shoulders his arms at it.
Mohammed Siraj begins with a length ball, shaping away from outside off. Shai Hope leaves it alone.

We are set to begin! The players stride out to the middle. Brandon King and Shai Hope will open the batting for West Indies. Before starting the game, the players take the knee in support of the BLM movement. Mohammed Siraj will begin the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
The teams line up for the national anthems. The national anthem of West Indies will be played followed by India's national anthem.
West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope (WK), Brandon King, Darren Bravo, Shamarh Brooks, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard (C), Jason Holder, Fabian Allen, Akeal Hosein, Alzarri Joseph, Kemar Roach.

India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Ishan Kishan, Virat Kohli, Rishabh Pant (WK), Suryakumar Yadav, Deepak Hooda, Washington Sundar, Shardul Thakur, Mohammed Siraj, Yuzvendra Chahal, Prasidh Krishna.

Kieron Pollard, the skipper of West Indies, says the toss is 50-50, they need to adapt to the conditions and play well. States the guys have to adapt according to the pitch and the conditions, they need to adjust mentally and bat longer as this is a 50-over game. Informs they have two changes, Roach and Fabian Allen come in, Darren Bravo also returns.

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India, says it looks like a good pitch and it won’t change a lot, it might get better under lights. Adds that he is happy to be back, playing for the country is the priority, it has been a couple of months since he has played and he is happy he is back. Mentions it is a historic day in Indian cricket and it has been a long journey for them and India has seen a lot of ups and downs but they have grown as a team. Informs Hooda is making his debut and they are playing with 6 batters and 5 bowlers.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and lands in the favour of India. They have elected to BOWL first.

PITCH REPORT -  Ian Bishop is near the pitch. He says that the pitch is nice and green. Adds that live grass has been removed in certain areas and also there are a few dry areas, the odd deliveries might grip off the surface. Mentions that this wicket looks like a good one to bat on, and if the dew arrives later in the day, batting will become even easier. So the captain winning the toss should ideally bowl first.
UPDATE - India have handed Deepak Hooda with his ODI cap. He is all set to make his ODI debut on India's 1000th ODI.

West Indies, on the other hand, are a team in transition. They have a lot of quality in their ranks, a lot of potential but it is now time to put that into use. They were quite poor against the Irish but will be high on confidence after beating England before coming here but in the shortest format. They though will need to be at their best if they are to win this. Toss and teams in a bit…

The major problem for India continues to be their middle order which was quite evident in their last series. However, their bowling also lacked the bite, except for Bumrah, the others did not have a great series against South Africa. The hosts are without their ace pacemen Shami and Bumrah in this one and it is a good chance for the others to step up.

Not only the Indians but West Indies have also not endured a good time in the ODI format in recent times. Both head into this series on the back of losses. India, failed to register a win in the ODI series against South Africa whereas, West Indies lost the series against Ireland in their own backyard. Both will be eager to win with the World Cup Super League points at stake. India are heavy favourites but West Indies do enjoy the conditions here so we could expect a few close games.

Cricket is back in India and it is the format in which the Indians have struggled in recent times, the 50-over format. They welcome West Indies for a three-game ODI series followed by a three-match T20I series. Welcome to the coverage of the first game India’s 1000th ODI game.
